description: Helga has asked that you prove your exploration capabilities once more by traversing through the forbidden temple of Mecethu-Kalaam, to the West of the Rainforest Order Encampment, and seeing what you can find there. She mentioned a staff of some great value buried with an ancient king.
name: The Forbidden Temple (MSQ)
completed: Return to Helga at her camp in the Lamavoria Frontier, to deliver the Star Staff, so she further understand the Esasa Culture.
